config.sourceBoundary: The world publishes coarse left/right light, charge, heat, and a sign-only temporal-light comparison. No private position, peak location, charge value, heat value, or score is written to controller memory.
config.stepOrder: Each frame shows the physical state and sensors before its action; the command produces the following frame.
config.cycleDefinition: Charge reaches 80; later heat is at most20, distance from the charger is at least3, and charge is at least20. This is external outcome accounting only.
worldRules: Light falls by4 per cell from100 at the source.
Charge change near the source: +9/+6/+3 at distance0/1/2; elsewhere−1, with an extra−1 for actual movement.
Heat rises5 within2cells, cools4 outside; heat90 or higher drains3 extra charge.
Starvation ticks mean charge≤5; overheat ticks mean heat≥90. Trials remain recoverable rather than terminating.
